messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — late-night triage for the dedicated capacity slate. Manifest says ~40 H100s due Wed 03:30 PT, but vendor flagged a potential odd/even power window on that datacenter. Can owners confirm impact?

Priya: @Alex noted. I think racks A3/A4 are on the odd PDUs; that could block simultaneous spin-up of full cabinets.

Marco: Confirmed — A3 is odd PDU. We can stagger node bring-up but need to update the reservation plan.

Alex: Staggering is fine, but we need to keep the canary window. Proposed plan: bring up 4 nodes in A3 as canary (2 GPUS each), wait 30m, then continue with A4. Does that preserve the perf baseline for canary tests?

Jordan: 30m should be ok. Ops: can you hold a short maintenance window and standby for rollback if temps spike? @OpsBot

OpsBot: Scheduled maintenance window request created: ticket #OPS-8942. Window tentative Wed 03:20-05:00 PT. Reply with :thumbsup: to approve.

Sasha: :thumbsup: from me. Also need to update reservation TTLs — the current dedicated reservations assume bulk activation at 04:00. We'll likely see a 45-60m drift.

Priya: Action items I see: 1) Update reservation schedule, 2) Amend canary runbook to reflect stagger, 3) Confirm power vendor acceptance. Assigning: Priya (1), Marco (2), Alex (3).

Marco: Working on canary runbook patch. Pushed draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/dedicated-canary/pull/214 — needs review (cc @Jordan @Sasha). Quick notes in PR about acceptance criteria:

```
Canary acceptance (staggered):
- 99th p95 latency within 1.1x baseline after warmup (10k tokens)
- KV cache hit rate >= 85% for canary prompts
- No GPU OOMs or thermal throttling events
- Health checks green for 30m post-warmup
```

Jordan: Reviewing now. One minor tweak: change warmup to 15k tokens to be safe given high variance.

Marco: Updated PR with 15k.

Alex: Vendor update — they replied: "we can swap PDU endpoints but it requires 2hr onsite; suggested approach is staggered activation." I'll forward the mail to infra-oncall.

Sasha: Reservation change: I updated the internal calendar and bumped the reservation TTL to +90m in the booking spreadsheet. Please also update the API reservation (CLI) so billing/overcommit checks stay accurate. Sample command below:

`ri reservations update --id res-0823 --start 2026-09-08T03:30:00Z --ttl PT1H30M`

Priya: I'll run that after Ops ticket is approved.

Jordan: Quick check — do we need fallback routing to another region if A3/A4 power fails? We have spare reserved nodes in us-west2 but bringing them online is slower. Thoughts?

Alex: We should have an automated fallback policy but try to avoid cross-region unless health degrades. Plan: automatic fallback only if canary fails or we detect power loss >= 15m. Documented in ops playbook.

Sasha: I'll add a config snippet to the rollout policy:

```
fallback:
  threshold_minutes: 15
  target_region: us-west2
  max_fallback_nodes: 8
  notify: ["#eng-oncall", "#support"]
```

Marco: One more ask — networking team, please pre-stage the cable bundles and patch plan for A3->leaf-12. We saw delays last time. @Jordan any contacts?

Jordan: I'll ping Nate from networking. Nate said he'll aim for a 02:30 PT staging window.

Priya: Final checklist before we close this thread:
- Ops ticket approved (:thumbsup)
- PR merged for canary runbook
- Reservation TTL updated via `ri` CLI
- Networking cable staging confirmed
- Vendor accepts stagger (email thread attached)

Alex: I'll follow up at 02:00 PT in case anything changes overnight. If anyone needs to hand off, drop a short note here. Thanks all.

Sasha: Leaving a short note for oncall: if you see thermal alerts during the 03:30-04:30 window, escalate to infra-oncall and flip fallback after 15m.

Jordan: Nate confirmed staging at 02:30.

OpsBot: Ticket #OPS-8942 status: approved by oncall (S. Patel). Maintenance window confirmed Wed 03:20-05:00 PT.

Priya: :rocket: merging canary PR now.

Marco: PR merged.

Alex: Great — last_message: confirmed that reservations TTL updated and vendor accepted stagger via email. Oncall, please proceed per playbook.

Jordan: Noted. I'll be monitoring the telemetry dashboards for the window.

Sasha: Thanks everyone, closing loop.
